title: Task 10b: API auth + rebinding guards (security review)
description: Security review on ec810e9: loopback API has no auth; DNS rebinding from a browser could POST apply/dreams.
acceptance_criteria:
- bearer token: <data_dir>/api-token created 0600 on first serve, printed at startup, required on every /v1/* route (401 problem+json otherwise); /healthz stays open
- Host header must be 127.0.0.1[:port] or localhost[:port] (403 otherwise)
- any Origin header that is not null/absent -> 403
- POST routes require Content-Type: application/json (415 otherwise) except routes with no body which must still reject a non-JSON content-type if one is sent
- tests cover each guard; live curl evidence; README/spec updated
notes: PASS: ef248f8 — bearer token at <data_dir>/api-token 0600, Host/Origin guards, JSON content-type, dreamd token subcommand, doctor line

title: Task 9: Apply and rollback
acceptance_criteria:
**Verify via:** cli
- After a completed stub dream, `dreamd apply <id>` exits 0, prints `applied <id>: backup at <path>`, the live memory dir now hashes equal to `out/`, `dreamd show <id>` says `applied`, and `dreamd scan` shows `last=<timestamp>` for the project.
- If a file in the live memory dir is modified between dream and apply, `dreamd apply <id>` exits 3 with `refused: memory changed since snapshot (rerun the dream or use --force)` and the live dir is untouched; `--force` applies anyway.
- `dreamd apply <id>` on a `failed` or already `applied` dream exits 3 with `refused: dream is <status>`.
- `dreamd rollback <id>` after apply exits 0, the live dir hashes equal to `in/`, status is `rolled_back`.
- With `DREAMD_FAIL_AFTER_BACKUP=1` (test hook) `apply` exits 4 and the live dir is still the original (hash equals `in/`).
notes: PASS: apply.rs landed in bfa5f67; apply/rollback sync, wrap in spawn_blocking for axum; ApplyError Display is bare text, CLI adds 'refused: '; interrupted swap self-heals
